name: Chaos Rush keeps a consistent distance whether the Felsworn is standing still or already moving (#9404)
contract: Chaos Rush Jump 802028 (SPELL_EFFECT_CHARGE_DEST) natively calls MotionMaster::MoveCharge at the fixed SPEED_CHARGE (42 yd/s), driven entirely server-side via the destination resolved in OnDestinationTargetSelect (MovePositionToFirstCollision(pos, 10yd, atan2(strafe, forward))). Moving straight forward (forward=1, strafe=0) resolves to angle 0, the same destination the native TARGET_DEST_CASTER_FRONT targeting would already pick while standing still, so the moving and standing casts must produce the identical ~10 yd displacement, and neither ever touches MOVE_RUN speed (the discarded run-speed-surge design did, and only while moving). The harness fixtures a held movement key without a client continuously steering position, so the discriminating evidence is that both the moving and the standing cast dash the full radius and that run speed stays flat throughout.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle

DISCRIMINATING: the moving cast still dashes the full 10 yd radius, same as standing still
DISCRIMINATING: the moving cast never touches run speed (no surge, no restore)

Distance to the dummy before the standing dash
REGRESSION: a standing caster still dashes forward the full SpellRadius 13 (10 yd)
